findings.session_summary: Initial Family Liaison session focused on clarifying communication barriers and establishing a cautious next step.
findings.primary_concern: Late or hard-to-understand notices affecting school attendance/participation; uncertainty about contact formats.

tracked_details.detail: Student reported missing a meeting date due to paper letter issues.
Uncertainty regarding alternative contact formats (e.g., voicemail vs. phone log).
Agreed between-session task: Ask guardian which contact time works best.

next_steps: Student to ask guardian about preferred contact times.
Check school office availability for alternative contact formats.
uncertainties: Availability of the school office for follow-up.
Actual receipt of any external support services (none confirmed).
findings.conclusion: This initial session established a supportive environment where the student felt heard but did not receive external service delivery. The main barrier (communication uncertainty) remains unresolved as no alternative contact format was confirmed. An agreed action (asking guardian about timing) is pending. Evidence supports that the session itself was helpful in clarifying steps, but it does not establish improvement in the school barrier or attendance.

findings.session_summary: Follow-up Family Liaison session focused on reviewing a pending task regarding guardian contact preferences, distinguishing between in-session rehearsal and external support delivery. The student reported that the main barrier (communication uncertainty) persists on some days but noted that early knowledge of plans helps. An in-session activity rehearsing an explanation of school needs was completed, though its effectiveness outside this room remains unverified.

findings.session_summary: Session 3 focused on reviewing the failure to complete a previous between-session task due to home/school timing conflicts. The mentor and student distinguished between in-session rehearsal of a contact request and external delivery. An in-session activity rehearsing a phrased request was completed, but no external service (e.g., confirmed contact with school office) was delivered or verified. The main barrier (uncertainty about contact formats/availability and timing difficulties) remains unresolved.
